purpose: Reproducible population-derived Hero comparison baseline for the preflop strategy benchmark. This is not the promoted v83 production strategy and must not be described as one.

runtime.action_sampling: deterministic weighted sampling from exact-node probabilities under the scenario Hero RNG stream
runtime.sizing: exact-node empirical sizing; JAM uses the legal all-in boundary

selection_provenance.preflop_model: Issue #101 retained the v5 production preflop model after the candidate failed its scientific gate.
selection_provenance.postflop_continuation: Issue #102 selected the persisted continuation overlay on VALIDATION with TEST unconsumed.

candidate_comparison.candidate_exact_context_rule: Use a #107 calculated decision only when its canonical preflop context and hand class match exactly.
candidate_comparison.candidate_out_of_support_rule: Fall back to this frozen reference policy and record the decision as out-of-support; never invent or nearest-neighbor a calculated Hero range.
candidate_comparison.postflop_rule: Reference and candidate use this same selected Model A continuation after the preflop street, so the paired comparison isolates the preflop policy change.

interpretation_limits: The reference samples a population-derived Model A policy and is not claimed to be an optimal Hero strategy.
The reference is not the promoted v83 preflop strategy: v83 has no validated autonomous preflop EV tree for the full OPEN/CALL/3BET/4BET/JAM action set.
A candidate beating this reference in simulation establishes only a conditional benchmark result under the frozen population and Model B sensitivity environments.
